evidence.point_data: Passed row status, row hash, and declared row checks in producer execution.

producer_assertions.weights: Second run completed. Initial run stopped on a missing redirected input before weight reduction.
producer_assertions.shared: Completed at the reported MEA parameter record.
producer_assertions.stability: Every supplied parent had unchanged exact coordinates within the release replay, and all requested trials were evaluated. The final no-resolved-descent assertion passed.
producer_assertions.stripper: Historical source and parameter hashes, installed wheel, Table 5 pressure, same-wheel reproduction limit, and all mixed-input band-table assertions passed.
producer_assertions.dea: Route verified the shared inputs and wheel SHA and installed bytes. rerun.error passed fitted row identity, count, status and tolerance assertions, and the 1e-8 replay limit passed. reduce, uncertainty, curves and search completed. The recheck exact availability assertion failed.

not_recalculated: Retained reduced-refit/evidence/F2 and F2 replay values used in the partly recalculated stripper band table.
DEA #398 comparison-point replay and reduction, and DEA presentation.
MDEA reported-point calculations and #343 critical-k replay
AMP fixed-slope reported-point calculations and AMODEL same-row deviations
Display regeneration, full display-input inventory, text diffs and number-source key check

Out of replay scope: all refits, starts and profiles; MEA reduced-refit parameter-details, fit-comparison and agreement tables; split-cause-342; AMP free-slope fit, AFREE rows and split figures; MDEA unbounded fit.
